01.title: Ifilimu Yenhlangano: Njengamanzi Agcwalisa Ulwandle
01.description: Inhlangano ye-P2P, umbono wayo nesisekelo sayo seBhayibheli, kanye nomsebenzi womhlaba wonke wokwenza abafundi — njengamanzi agcwalisa ulwandle.

units.u002: Cabanga ngomhlaba lapho ukwazi inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu kugcwalisa umhlaba, njengamanzi agcwalisa ulwandle.

02.title: Umbono we-P2P Global
02.description: Kungani i-P2P ikhona: wonke umuntu ufunda komunye futhi usiza omunye ukuba akhule, kusuka esizukulwaneni kuya kwesinye.

units.u001: Konke ukuphila kokholo kuqala ngomuntu othile owakhathalela ngokwanele ukuba akwabelane.
units.u003: Umngane owachaza ukuthi umusa usho ukuthini ngempela.
units.u004: Uthisha owasala ukuze aphendule omunye umbuzo.
units.u007: Ukholo luhlale luhamba kanje: kusuka kumuntu kuya komunye, kusuka esizukulwaneni kuya kwesilandelayo.
units.u008: UPawulu watshela uThimothewu ukuba aphathise lokho akwamukele abantu abathembekile, abazokwazi ukufundisa nabanye.
units.u009: Umkholwa oyedwa usiza omunye umkholwa ukuba akhule.
units.u015: Kuze kube ukwazi inkazimulo yeNkosi kugcwalisa umhlaba, njengamanzi agcwalisa ulwandle.
units.u017: Futhi wonke umuntu angasiza omunye ukuba akhule.

overlays.l04: Umndeni owodwa.  Isonto elilodwa.  Umphakathi owodwa.  Isizwe esisodwa.
overlays.l07: Futhi wonke umuntu angasiza omunye ukuba akhule.

03.title: Wamukelekile ku-P2P
03.description: Ukubuka kokuqala i-P2P: Ikhaya, Ukufunda, IBhayibheli, Imilayezo Nokunye — nendlela konke okuxhumene ngayo.

units.u001: Wamukelekile ku-P2P Global, i-Peer to Peer Global Discipleship Network.
units.u002: I-P2P yindawo yokufunda iZwi likaNkulunkulu, ukuliqonda, ukuphila ngalo nokusiza omunye ukuba akhule.
units.u003: Ake sihambe uhambo olufushane ukuze wazi ukuthi yini ikuphi.
units.u005: Nsuku zonke uzothola iZwi Losuku: ivesi elinesiqondiso esifushane sokulisebenzisa.
units.u006: Ungavula sonke isahluko, usilalele, futhi ubone isigaba sakho sokukhula ngokushesha.
units.u007: Ithebhu ethi Ukufunda yilapho ukhula khona ekuqondeni.
units.u008: I-Kingdom School ikuhola ku-Core Foundations, isifundo ngesifundo.
units.u010: I-P2P Plans ikusiza ukuba ufunde isihloko ngesivinini sakho, futhi i-Study Together ikuvumela ukuba ufunde nabanye.
units.u011: Kuthebhu yeBhayibheli ungafunda imiBhalo ngezinguqulo nangezilimi eziningi.
units.u012: Lalela nge-audio player, umake amavesi akhuluma nawe, uqhathanise izinguqulo eceleni kwazo, futhi useshe kulo lonke iBhayibheli.
units.u014: Xoxa nabantu ofunda nabo, wakhe amaqembu angasese, futhi ubhale izincwadi ezinde nge-P2P Mail.
units.u015: Ngaphansi kokuthi Okunye uzothola Umthandazo, onezindlela zomthandazo eziqondisiwe, ukuthandaza ngemiBhalo nedayari yomthandazo.
units.u016: Uzothola futhi ukuthi Hlola, lapho ungaxhumana khona nabanye abakholwayo, uthole isonto lakho, futhi wazi ngemisebenzi yobuvangeli.
units.u017: Iphrofayela Yami ilandisa indaba yakho: ukukhula kwakho, ubudlelwane bakho bobufundi, nohambo lwakho kusuka eMbewini kuya eHlumeni, eSithombeni, eSihlahleni Esithelayo nakuMakhi Wehlathi.
units.u018: Ukukhula lapha kubonisa izinyathelo zangempela ozithathile.
units.u022: Futhi khumbula: wonke umuntu ufunda komunye, futhi usiza omunye ukuba akhule.

04.title: Uyini u-Peer Guide?
04.description: Uyini u-Peer Guide, kungani kukhona ukuqondiswa ngontanga, nokuthi umqondisi uhamba kanjani nomuntu okhulayo.

units.u001: Cabanga ngomuntu owake wamtshela ngoJesu: umngane, umakhelwane, umuntu owahlangana naye kanye kuphela.
units.u003: Ufunda iBhayibheli, kodwa unemibuzo futhi akaqiniseki ukuthi uzoqala kuphi.
units.u004: Ukukhula okholweni bekungahlosiwe ukuba kwenziwe umuntu eyedwa.
units.u006: If one falls down, his companion can lift him up.
units.u010: Wakhetha iqembu elincane ukuba libe naye: wadla nabo, waphendula imibuzo yabo, futhi wathandaza nabo.
units.u011: Futhi nabakholwa bokuqala bakhula kanjalo, bekhuthazana nsuku zonke.
units.u012: Ku-P2P, u-Peer Guide ngumkholwa okanye nawe osesinyathelweni esisodwa phambili ohambweni lobufundi.
units.u013: Akayena umfundisi noma uthisha, kodwa ngumuntu nje osehambe kule ndlela futhi ozimisele ukuhamba eceleni kwakho manje.
units.u014: U-Peer Guide wakho udlula nawe ezifundweni, uphendula imibuzo yakho, ufunda ukuzindla kwakho futhi uthandaza nawe.
units.u015: Mbheke njengomngane womoya onolwazi oluncane ngaphezulu.
units.u016: Uma uqala ukujoyina i-P2P, ungacela u-Peer Guide.
units.u017: Bhala imbingelelo emfushane, futhi ungaqala uhambo lwakho ngokushesha ngesikhathi kusafunwa umuntu ofanele wena.
units.u018: Kamuva, ungahlala uvula i-Find a Peer Guide ukuze uthole umuntu ofanele.
units.u019: U-Peer Guide akathathi indawo kaKristu, imiBhalo, umfundisi wakho noma umsebenzi kaMoya oNgcwele.
units.u020: UPawulu wakusho kalula: I planted, Apollos watered, but God made it grow.
units.u021: U-Peer Guide ngumhambi okanye nawe endleleni.
units.u022: Futhi ngelinye ilanga, owaqondiswa uba ngumqondisi.
units.u023: Lokho okwamukele, ukudlulisela kumuntu osemuva kwakho ngesinyathelo esisodwa.
units.u024: Yile ndlela ubufundi obukhula ngayo: kusuka ekuphileni kuya kokunye, kusuka esizukulwaneni kuya kwesilandelayo.
units.u025: Wonke umuntu ufunda komunye, futhi usiza omunye ukuba akhule.

overlays.l02: U-Peer Guide ngumkholwa okanye nawe osesinyathelweni esisodwa phambili kulolu hambo.
overlays.l05: Wonke umuntu ufunda komunye, futhi usiza omunye ukuba akhule.
overlays.l06: Ubani ohamba nawe?  Futhi wena uhamba nobani?
overlays.outro2: Ubani ohamba nawe — futhi wena uhamba nobani?

05.title: Isonto Elenza Abafundi
05.description: Indlela i-P2P esekela ngayo ukwenza abafundi esontweni: ukuhlomisa abaholi, ukunakekela amalungu nokuthumela abantu.

units.u001: Ngaphambi kokuba enyukele ezulwini, uJesu wanika ibandla lakhe umyalo ocacile: hambani nenze izizwe zonke zibe ngabafundi, nizifundise ukugcina konke enaniyalile.
units.u002: Ukwenza abafundi bekuhlale kwenzeka empilweni yebandla.
units.u006: Nangobungane, lapho umkholwa oyedwa esiza omunye ukuba akhule.
units.u007: UKristu wanikeza abelusi nabafundisi ukuze bahlomise abantu bakhe emsebenzini wenkonzo.
units.u008: Kodwa kusukela kwelinye iSonto kuya kwelinye, kungaba nzima ukwazi ukuthi ubani okhulayo, ubani odonsa kanzima, nokuthi yisiphi isinyathelo esilandelayo somuntu ngamunye.
units.u009: I-P2P Global yakhelwe ukusiza isonto lendawo ukuba liqinise lowo msebenzi, hhayi ukuthatha indawo yawo.
units.u010: Noma yiliphi isonto lingabhalisa ku-P2P mahhala ngokuphelele, limeme amalungu alo ngekhodi, futhi libanike indawo okwabelwana ngayo yokufunda nokukhula ndawonye.
units.u011: Endaweni yesonto, abaholi bathola ingxoxo yesonto, amafayela nezinsiza, imihlangano, amaqembu amancane nezaziso.
units.u012: Amalungu angalandela izisekelo ze-Kingdom School futhi afunde ndawonye, kuyilapho ngamunye enenqubekela phambili yakhe.
units.u013: Isonto lingafunda ndawonye isifundo esifanayo se-Kingdom School noma i-Kingdom Story efanayo.
units.u014: Amaqembu amancane angaqhubeka ngesivinini sawo, kuyilapho ilungu ngalinye ligcina inqubekela phambili yalo nokuzindla kwalo.
units.u015: Endleleni, amalungu aqeda ukuhlolwa okufushane kokuqonda futhi abhale ukuzindla komuntu siqu kudayari yawo yobufundi, ukuze ukufunda kube ukuqonda, nokuqonda kube ukuphila okuguquliwe.
units.u016: Isifinyezo somphakathi sibonisa ukuthi bangaki abantu abafunda ngenkuthalo.
units.u017: Sibonisa futhi ngobumnene amalungu angasebenzanga isikhathi esithile, nabakholwa abasha abangakabi nomqondisi, ukuze kungabikho onyamalala buthule.
units.u018: Futhi ngoba ubufundi abupheleli emnyango wesonto, imindeni ingakha i-Family Circle ukuze ithandaze futhi ifunde ndawonye ekhaya, kuyilapho ama-Peer Guides esiza abakholwa abasha ukuba bahambe nomuntu osesinyathelweni esisodwa phambili.
units.u019: I-P2P ayithathi indawo yomfundisi wakho, yebandla elihlangene noma yomsebenzi kaMoya oNgcwele.
units.u020: Iyithuluzi lokusiza ibandla ukuba lenze lokho imiBhalo esevele ikuchazile: abakholwa abaqinile emfundisweni yabaphostoli nasebudlelwaneni, abadlulisela lokho abakwamukele kubantu abathembekile, abazofundisa nabanye.
units.u021: Isonto elenza abafundi livusa abantu abenza abafundi emizini yabo, ezindaweni zabo zomsebenzi nasemiphakathini yabo.
units.u022: Letha isonto lakho ku-P2P Global futhi nikhule ndawonye.

overlays.l03: Bhalisa isonto lakho — mahhala, akukho okubhaliselwayo
overlays.outro2: Khulani ndawonye. Yenzani abafundi abenza abafundi.

06.title: IBhayibheli ne-Deep Study
06.description: Ukufunda iBhayibheli ngolimi lwakho, nokulifunda ngokujulile ngamathuluzi asiza ukuqonda.

units.u002: Umhubi wayibiza ngokuthi isibani ezinyaweni zakhe nokukhanya endleleni yakhe.
units.u004: Lapho abaseBereya bezwa umlayezo, bawamukela ngentshiseko futhi bahlola imiBhalo nsuku zonke.
units.u005: I-P2P yakhelwe ukukusiza ukuba wenze okufanayo: ukufunda, ukulalela, ukuqonda nokuphila ngalokho okuthola.
units.u006: Vula ithebhu yeBhayibheli bese ukhetha noma iyiphi incwadi nesahluko.
units.u007: Funda ngezinguqulo nangezilimi eziningi, futhi ushintshe phakathi kwazo noma nini.
units.u008: Uma ukhetha ukulalela, i-audio player ifunda imiBhalo ngokuzwakalayo, ukuze iZwi likuphelezele lapho uhamba, usebenza noma uphumula.
units.u011: Buza ukuthi ikubonisani ngoNkulunkulu, ngabantu, nangendlela yokuphila.
units.u012: Bese uyibuyisela kuNkulunkulu ngomthandazo, futhi uthole indlela eyodwa yokuyilalela namuhla.
units.u013: Khetha ivesi ozolimaka, bese uligcine emtatsheni wakho weBhayibheli.
units.u014: Qhathanisa ivesi ezinguqulweni eziningana eceleni kwazo.
units.u015: Futhi useshe igama noma isihloko kulo lonke iBhayibheli.
units.u016: Uma ufuna ukujula, i-Bible Study ivula indawo ehlukile yokufunda ngokucophelela.
units.u017: Ku-Deep Study uzothola isichazamazwi seBhayibheli, izindatshana zokubhekisela, izincazelo namathuluzi okufunda amagama abonisa incazelo yamagama okuqala.
units.u018: I-Deep Study ayithathi indawo yokufunda iBhayibheli.
units.u020: Okokuqala ufunda umbhalo, bese uwufunda ngokucophelela, ukuze ukuqonda kuholele okholweni nasekulaleleni.
units.u021: All Scripture is God-breathed, and useful for instruction and for training in righteousness.

overlays.p01s: Yonke incwadi, sonke isahluko, / izinguqulo eziningi
overlays.l05: Lifunde.  Lilalele.  Lifundisise.  Futhi uphile ngalo.
overlays.outro2: Izwi lakho liyisibani ezinyaweni zami nokukhanya endleleni yami.

07.title: Ukufunda ku-P2P
07.description: Ukuthi ukufunda ku-P2P kunjani — izifundo, izindaba, izinhlelo, ukufunda ngamaqembu, ukuzindla nokukhula.

units.u002: Kumayelana nokukhula ekuqondeni, ukuze iqiniso libumbe indlela ophila ngayo.
units.u003: Ake silandele umfundi oyedwa, uGrace, ohambweni lwakhe.
units.u005: I-Core Foundations ibeka isisekelo esiqinile, ingxenye ngengxenye: iqala ngesethulo se-Peer-to-Peer, bese kuba yiVangeli neNsindiso, futhi iqhubeke ezisekelweni zokholo lobuKristu.
units.u006: Uma esekulungele ukuqhubeka, izifundo zokuzikhethela zinikeza izinhlelo nezifundo ngezihloko eziningi.
units.u007: Isifundo ngasinye sivula imiBhalo, siyichaze ngokucacile, futhi siphetha ngemibuzo emsiza ukuba aqonde futhi asebenzise lokho akufundile.
units.u008: Eceleni kwezifundo zakhe, i-Kingdom Stories ivula abantu nezehlakalo zeBhayibheli, njengo-Abrahama, indoda eyakholwa isithembiso sikaNkulunkulu, isahluko ngesahluko.
units.u009: Endleleni, ukuhlolwa okufushane kokuqonda kumsiza ukuba asho ngamazwi akhe lokho akufundile.
units.u010: Ukukubhala kusiza iqiniso ukuba lisuke engqondweni liye enhliziyweni.
units.u011: Uma efuna ukuhlola isihloko esifana nothando, i-P2P Plans ingamsiza akhe uhlelo lokufunda lomuntu siqu, nemiBhalo, okufundwayo okusekelayo, nohlelo oluhambisana nempilo yakhe.
units.u013: Nge-Study Together, uGrace angamema umngane, i-Family Circle yakhe noma isonto lakhe ukuba bafunde ndawonye i-Kingdom Story efanayo noma isifundo se-Kingdom School.
units.u014: Ngamunye ugcina inqubekela phambili yakhe, futhi ukuzindla kwakhe kuhlala kuyimfihlo ngaphandle uma ekhetha ukwabelana ngakho.
units.u015: I-Learning Centre yakhe ihlanganisa konke endaweni eyodwa: ukuhlolwa okusamele akwenze, umsebenzi asewuthumele, nempendulo uma ifika.
units.u016: Futhi ku-Discipleship Journal yakhe, ubhala ukuzindla kwakhe.
units.u020: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukukhula kwakhe kuyabhalwa ngobufakazi bangempela: izifundo aziqondile, iqiniso alisebenzisile, nabantu abasizile.
units.u021: Isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, kusuka eMbewini, kuya kuMakhi Wehlathi.
units.u022: Futhi njengoba ekhula, uqala ukusiza abanye: umema umngane ukuba bafunde ndawonye, futhi ngelinye ilanga, uhamba eceleni komuntu osanda kuqala.
units.u024: ImiBhalo isibiza ukuba sibe ngabenzi beZwi, hhayi abalaleli kuphela.
units.u025: Ku-P2P, konke okufundayo kungokwokuphila nokudlulisela kwabanye.

overlays.l01: Ukukhula ekuqondeni, ukuze iqiniso libumbe indlela ophila ngayo
overlays.p12s: Lapho wonke umuntu eqala khona — / Grace
overlays.l03: Funda iqiniso.  Phila iqiniso.  Siza omunye akhule.
overlays.outro2: Funda iqiniso. Phila iqiniso. Siza omunye akhule.

08.title: Ubufundi Buqala Ekhaya
08.description: Ukwenza abafundi emndenini nase-Family Circle: ukufunda, ukuthandaza nokukhula ndawonye ekhaya.

units.u001: Kudala ngaphambi kokuba ingane ihlale ekilasini noma ebhentshini lesonto, ifunda ekhaya.
units.u005: UNkulunkulu watshela abantu bakhe ukuba bagcine iZwi lakhe ezinhliziyweni zabo futhi balifundise abantwana babo ngokukhuthala: lapho behlezi endlini, nalapho behamba endleleni.
units.u009: Ugogo noma umkhulu olandisa ukuthi uNkulunkulu ube ethembeke kanjani.
units.u011: Ukholo lukaThimothewu lwaqala ukuhlala kugogo wakhe uLowisi nakunina u-Ewunike.
units.u012: Ukholo luvame ukudluliselwa ngempilo yomndeni evamile, usuku nosuku.
units.u013: Bubukeka futhi njengabazali abalalelayo: abenzela imibuzo eqotho indawo, futhi abangesabi ukuthi, "Angazi."
units.u015: I-Family Circle ku-P2P inika umndeni wakho indawo okwabelwana ngayo yalokho.
units.u016: Yakha indilinga yakho bese umema umndeni wakho.
units.u019: Yabelanani ngezicelo zomthandazo zomndeni, nifunde ndawonye, futhi nibuyele emihlanganweni enibe nayo ndawonye.
units.u021: Izingane zingabona ukholo luphilwa phambi kwamehlo azo.
units.u025: As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.

overlays.outro2: Kodwa mina nendlu yami siyakukhonza uJehova.

units.u001: Kudala, uNkulunkulu wakhipha phandle indoda egama layo ngu-Abrahama wayitshela ukuba ibheke esibhakabhakeni ibale izinkanyezi, uma ingakwazi.
units.u005: Isizwe sathunjelwa kude, futhi sabuyiselwa ekhaya.
units.u006: Futhi lapho isikhathi sesigcwalisekile, uNkulunkulu wathuma iNdodana yakhe.
units.u009: Abalandeli bakhe bathwala umlayezo besuka eJerusalema baze bafika emikhawulweni yomhlaba.
units.u010: Ibandla lokuqala lahlangana, lathandaza, lahlupheka futhi lakhula.
units.u012: Futhi konke okwalotshwa ngaphambili kwalotshelwa ukusifundisa, ukuze sibe nethemba.
units.u014: Iqoqo elikhulayo labantu nezehlakalo zeBhayibheli, nelebandla kuzo zonke izinkathi.

10.title: Kingdom School
10.description: Imfundiso yeBhayibheli ehlelekile eyakha isisekelo esiqinile, isifundo ngesifundo.

units.u001: UJesu wathi noma ubani ozwa amazwi akhe futhi awenze ufana nendoda ehlakaniphile eyakha indlu yayo phezu kwedwala.
units.u002: Izimpilo eziqinile zakhiwa phezu kwezisekelo eziqinile.
units.u003: I-Kingdom School yindlela ehlelekile ye-P2P Global ezisekelweni zokholo lobuKristu.
units.u004: I-Core Foundations iqala ngesethulo se-Peer-to-Peer, neVangeli neNsindiso, futhi iqhubeka isinyathelo ngesinyathelo ezifundweni ezingaphezu kwekhulu namashumi ayisishiyagalombili, futhi zisakhula.
units.u005: Izifundo zokuzikhethela zinikeza izinhlelo nezifundo zokuqhubeka.
units.u006: Isifundo ngasinye sivula imiBhalo, siyichaze, futhi sihlole ukuqonda kwakho, ukuze ulwazi lube ukukholiseka, nokukholiseka kube ukuphila okuguquliwe.

overlays.l02: Funda ngendlela ehlelekile.  Qonda ngokujulile.  Phila ngokwethembeka.
overlays.outro2: Kingdom School — kuthebhu ethi Ukufunda ku-P2P Global.

11.title: Kusuka Ekufundeni Kuya Ekuphileni
11.description: Indlela esikufundayo okubumba ngayo impilo yansuku zonke, ubudlelwane, izinqumo nenkonzo.

units.u002: Ivesi elifundwa ekuseni kakhulu, ngaphambi kokuba usuku lube matasa.
units.u004: Uvula isifundo, futhi abheke eduze ukuthi lisho ukuthini.
units.u010: Isinqumo esincane sokuthi uzophila kanjani namuhla.
units.u013: Emsebenzini, ukhuluma iqiniso, ngisho noma bekuzoba lula ukungakhulumi.
units.u014: Endaweni yakhe, ubona umuntu odinga usizo, bese emisa.
units.u015: NgeSonto, ukhonza nesonto lakhe, futhi alalele iZwi elishunyayelwayo.
units.u016: Esikoleni sendodana yakhe, ufunda nengane enenkinga yokufunda.
units.u020: ImiBhalo isibiza ukuba sibe ngabenzi beZwi, hhayi abalaleli kuphela.
units.u021: Umngane wakhe umbuza ukuthi yini eshintshile.
units.u023: Emasontweni ambalwa kamuva, lowo mngane uvula ivesi elifanayo futhi aqale ukukhula.
units.u024: Ngakho baqala ukufunda ndawonye, kanye ngesonto.
units.u028: Futhi ngelinye ilanga, lowo mngane uzokwenzela omunye okufanayo.
units.u031: Iqiniso esilamukelayo lihloselwe ukubumba indlela esiphila ngayo, nendlela esisiza ngayo abanye bakhule.

overlays.l03: Iqiniso esilamukelayo lihloselwe ukubumba indlela esiphila ngayo.

overlays.outro2: Funda iqiniso. Phila iqiniso. Siza omunye akhule.
